ValidationRule.description: To restrict agent to edit closed case assigned to bottling company queue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, 'US'), BEGINS(OwnerId,"00G"), BEGINS(Owner:Queue.QueueName ,'CCNA'), CONTAINS(RIGHT(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, 2), 'BC'), OR(NOT(ISCHANGED(OwnerId)),CONTAINS(RIGHT(PRIORVALUE(Case_Owner_Name__c),2),'BC')), $UserRole.Name='CCNA Frontline Agent', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to edit the closed case which is assigned to Bottling Company Queue.
